title: Frontend-local build artifact (ZIP) packaging workflow and discovery UI

requirements.summary: Provide a repeatable local workflow (invoked from the frontend workspace) that builds backend + frontend outputs and packages them into a single ZIP containing build outputs and a short deployment README.
acceptanceCriteria: Running the packaging workflow outputs exactly one ZIP file (e.g., in a dedicated /dist or /artifacts folder) without manual steps beyond invoking the workflow.
The ZIP contains backend build outputs needed to deploy the canister(s) (e.g., wasm + candid/interface files as produced by the normal build).
The ZIP contains the frontend production build output (static assets) as produced by the normal frontend build.
The ZIP includes a short README (English) with steps to deploy locally using dfx, including any environment/setup prerequisites.
If packaging fails, the workflow prints a clear, actionable error message identifying the failed step (backend build, frontend build, or zipping).

file_operations.description: Create a deterministic, repeatable packaging script (single command) that (1) runs the normal backend build from repo root, (2) runs the normal frontend production build, (3) assembles only required build outputs plus deployment README into a staging folder, and (4) produces exactly one ZIP at a fixed location (e.g., frontend/artifacts/app-build.zip). Ensure clear, actionable console errors for each step (backend build, frontend build, zipping) and a clear success message printing the final ZIP path + filename.

Add a short English README to be included in the ZIP describing prerequisites and local deployment steps using dfx (from a clean checkout), including how to use the packaged backend outputs and how to serve/deploy the packaged frontend static build.
Ensure the artifacts folder exists in source control without committing generated ZIP outputs.

Document the packaging workflow in English, including the single command to run (frontend/scripts/package-artifact.sh) and the expected output ZIP location/filename. This documentation must align with the script's printed messages.

requirements.summary: Add a lightweight in-app developer/operator entry-point that clearly tells where to find the generated ZIP and (optionally) fetches build artifact info from the backend for easy retrieval.
acceptanceCriteria: After a successful build/package run, the location and filename of the generated ZIP are printed clearly to the console/log output.
There is a single documented command (in English) to generate the ZIP from a clean checkout, suitable for re-trying if a prior attempt failed.

file_operations.description: Add a React Query hook (e.g., useBuildArtifactsInfo) that calls the existing backend capability getBuildArtifacts() and returns the resulting string for display in the UI (no backend changes).

Add a small 'Download ZIP (Developers/Operators)' card/section (English text) explaining the single command to generate the ZIP and the expected output path/filename. Include a button to fetch and display backend-reported artifact info (via the new hook) when available. Use existing shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card, Button, Alert/Dialog) to keep UI consistent—verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
